description: This file defines the PsrCacheAdapter class which implements cache operations (get, set, remove) by delegating to an underlying PSR CacheItemPoolInterface.

classes.name: PsrCacheAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class implementing cache interface using PSR CacheItemPool, providing get, set, and remove cache operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting a CacheItemPoolInterface to manage cache operations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a cached value by key, returns null if cache miss.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Store a value in cache with an optional TTL (time-to-live).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove a cache item by key.
